name: Behavior Contract Gate
summary: Separate dataset, runtime evidence and grading, then block releases on every applicable deterministic case contract.
context: An Agent release has tool, state, safety, retrieval, trajectory or cost behavior beyond final text quality.
One critical case must not be masked by an aggregate score.
forces: Deterministic metrics are strict but require owned expected behavior.
Judge metrics cover semantics but are probabilistic and provenance-sensitive.
Full traces improve diagnosis while increasing retention and privacy burden.
decision: Keep EvalDataset, TraceSet and SuiteReport as separate versioned artifacts.
Require complete case identity and per-case deterministic blockers.
Keep judge results advisory until calibration and failure policy are explicit.
implementation: Generate evidence without assigning a verdict.
Preserve tool arguments, trajectory, state, errors, policy and domain evidence.
Fail closed on missing required evidence or NOT_EVALUATED metrics.
Map the final blocking report to a nonzero CI process status.

observable_contract.statement: Generated trace case IDs exactly match the versioned input dataset.
Every applicable deterministic metric passes per case before the suite can pass.
Dataset, generated trace and grade report remain distinct serializable artifacts.
The baseline exits zero and a deliberately broken architecture suite exits nonzero.

failure_modes.statement: A mean score passes while one critical invocation or case violates its contract.
Failed inference cases are dropped and a partial TraceSet is still graded as complete.
A fluent judge score overrides deterministic tool, state, policy or retrieval failures.
Result comparison reports numeric deltas but does not define a release-blocking decision.

counterexamples.context: Several trajectories are intentionally equivalent and owned state/effect outcomes are sufficient.
counterexamples.preferred: Evaluate the stable outcome contract rather than an exact tool sequence.

counterexamples.context: A semantic judge has not been calibrated for drift, sampling or failure review.
counterexamples.preferred: Keep it advisory and retain deterministic blockers for critical policy.

adk_versions.notes: Cross-phase runtime traces were normalized from the pinned ADK Event and Session surfaces.
Dataset, generate, grade and compare lifecycle informed the artifact separation and policy gaps.

source_evidence.claim: EvalCase defines static/scenario cases, Session input and reduced invocation evidence.
LocalEvalService separates inference, metric evaluation, invocation results and case status.
TrajectoryEvaluator compares exact tool calls and averages invocation scores.
Agents CLI stores datasets, generated traces and graded results as separate lifecycle artifacts.
Trace generation records per-case inference failures but can complete with partial successful cases.
Compare produces recursive diffs and deltas without a release policy or blocking status.

lab_evidence.claim: Tests enforce dataset/trace identity, serialization and all-cases aggregation.
Six deliberate architecture breakages fail deterministic metrics while a scripted judge passes.
The baseline returns zero and the broken suite returns one.

rejected_decisions.decision: Use one aggregate response-quality score as the release gate.
rejected_decisions.reason: Compensation hides critical case failures and discards ownership of the failed dimension.
rejected_decisions.replacement: Use per-case deterministic blockers plus separately reported aggregate and judge metrics.
